2026-10-23T17:55:36.8916901Z   pr_body: ## Summary

`test-and-mark-stable.yml` with `skip_e2e=true` never tags a release. Run 39955031510 on 2026-10-23 is an example: `validate` passed, the run concluded `success`, but `release` and `sync-to-main` were skipped. The latest tag stayed v1.38.2.

Cause: the `release` job gated on `${{ success() && !inputs.gate_only }}`. GitHub's `success()` is false when any ancestor job was skipped, and `skip_e2e` skips every live e2e job, so `release` could not run on that path. `sync-to-main` had no status function, so GitHub applied an implicit `success()` with the same effect.

Fix:
- `release`: `!cancelled() && !inputs.gate_only && needs.source.result == 'success' && needs.resolve-version.result == 'success' && needs.validate.result == 'success'`.

2026-10-23T17:55:36.8904695Z   pr_title: Tag releases when test-and-mark-stable runs with skip_e2e=true
2026-10-23T17:55:36.8916414Z   pr_body: ## Summary

`test-and-mark-stable.yml` with `skip_e2e=true` never tags a release. Run 39955031510 on 2026-10-23 is an example: `validate` passed, the run concluded `success`, but `release` and `sync-to-main` were skipped. The latest tag stayed v1.38.2.

Cause: the `release` job gated on `${{ success() && !inputs.gate_only }}`. GitHub's `success()` is false when any ancestor job was skipped, and `skip_e2e` skips every live e2e job, so `release` could not run on that path. `sync-to-main` had no status function, so GitHub applied an implicit `success()` with the same effect.

Fix:
- `release`: `!cancelled() && !inputs.gate_only && needs.source.result == 'success' && needs.resolve-version.result == 'success' && needs.validate.result == 'success'`.
